name: Z-75 Headhunter
description: The Z-75 Headhunter was a model of starship. The mechanic Jarek Yeager used pieces of a Z-75 Headhunter—rumored to be an engine—alongside pieces of a T-65B X-wing starfighter, to create the racing starfighter known as the Fireball. According to rumors, Yeager had used a Z-75 inherited from members of his family in the construction of the Fireball.
